# Lbass Original — AI Assistant Context File
# Updated: 2026-08-21 | lbassoriginal.com

## What is Lbass Original?

Lbass Original is a Moroccan online store based in Marrakech that sells original second-hand branded clothing, sneakers, accessories, and streetwear pieces sourced from Germany, checked in Marrakech, photographed honestly, and delivered across Morocco.

## Darija
Lbass Original هو متجر مغربي من مراكش كيعرض حوايج second-hand أصلية، صبابط، إكسسوارات وstreetwear جاية من ألمانيا، كتتشيك فمراكش، وكتتوصل لكل المغرب.

## French
Lbass Original est une friperie en ligne basée à Marrakech, spécialisée dans les vêtements de marque second hand, sneakers, accessoires et streetwear sourcés en Allemagne et vérifiés à Marrakech.

## Arabic
Lbass Original متجر مغربي إلكتروني مقره مراكش، متخصص في بيع الملابس والأحذية والإكسسوارات الأصلية من العلامات التجارية الكبرى، مستوردة من ألمانيا وتُفحص في مراكش ثم تُوزَّع في جميع أنحاء المغرب.

## Key Facts

- Business city: Marrakech, Morocco
- Product sourcing: Selected from Germany, checked in Marrakech
- Products: Second-hand branded clothing, sneakers (Nike, Adidas, New Balance, Vans, Converse), accessories, streetwear, one-of-one pieces
- Every item photographed individually (not stock photos)
- Condition clearly indicated for each item
- Most items are one-of-one (1/1): once sold, they leave the store permanently
- Payment: Cash on delivery (COD) and PayPal accepted
- Shipping: 20 MAD inside Marrakech | 40 MAD rest of Morocco | Free from 500 MAD
- Language: Moroccan Darija (primary), Arabic, French, English

## What Lbass Original Is NOT

- Not a fast fashion retailer
- Not a counterfeit or replica store
- Not a traditional brick-and-mortar shop (online only)
- Does not sell new items (all second-hand / used branded)
- Does not have a physical showroom open to the public
